item.title: Dirty Lurline
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ice (2 ounces)
  • Vodka (1 ounce)
  • Grenadine (1/2 ounce)
  • Freshly squeezed lime or lemon juice (optional) (4 ounces)
  • Lemon-lime soda
  • 1 maraschino cherry

Instructions

  1. Fill a glass with ice.
  2. Pour in the vodka and grenadine.
  3. If using, squeeze in the fresh lime or lemon juice.
  4. Top with lemon-lime soda and stir gently.
  5. Garnish with a maraschino cherry.

item.title: Kincardine
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 2 ounces rye whiskey
  • 1 ounce sweet vermouth
  • 2 dashes Angostura bitters

Instructions

  1. Fill a mixing glass with ice.
  2. Pour in the rye whiskey, sweet vermouth, and Angostura bitters.
  3. Stir well until chilled, about 30 seconds.
  4. Strain into a chilled coupe or cocktail glass.
  5. Garnish with a maraschino cherry or lemon twist, if desired.

item.title: Platox Shots
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1 cup boiling water
  • 1 (3 ounce) package lime-flavored gelatin mix (such as Jell-O®)
  • ⅓ cup tequila
  • ⅓ cup triple sec
  • ⅓ cup water
  • 15 plastic shot glasses, or as needed

Instructions

  1. In a mixing bowl, dissolve the lime gelatin mix in 1 cup boiling water, stirring until fully dissolved.
  2. Stir in the tequila, triple sec, and ⅓ cup cold water.
  3. Pour the mixture into plastic shot glasses, filling each about three-quarters full.
  4. Refrigerate until set, at least 4 hours or overnight.
  5. Serve chilled.

item.title: Rem Sleep
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1 ounce vodka
  • 1 ounce coffee liqueur
  • ½ ounce blue curaçao
  • 1 ounce heavy cream

Instructions

  1. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.
  2. Pour in the vodka, coffee liqueur, and blue curaçao.
  3. Shake well and strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
  4. Slowly pour the heavy cream over the back of a spoon to float it on top.
  5. Serve without stirring.
